# Fable List

> A hand-checked index of 222 live works and 146 video demos that 241 creators built with Claude Fable 5.2 (Anthropic, released 2026-11-09): browser games, 3D worlds, web tools and code-driven films. Every link is opened before it is added; updated every 12 hours. Last updated 2026-11-21.

Each work has a detail page with the creator, the live link, the original X post, like count and a GIF preview. The site is available in 10 languages (/zh/, /zh-tw/, /ja/, /ko/, /es/, /pt/, /fr/, /de/, /ru/). Source list: https://github.com/fengyiqicoder/awesome-fable-5.2

## Sections

- [Games](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/games/): 103 entries
- [3D Worlds & Scenes](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/3d-worlds/): 47 entries
- [Web Pages & Tools](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/web-and-tools/): 53 entries
- [Animation & Film](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/animation/): 19 entries
- [Video Demos](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/video-demos/): 146 entries

## Facts

- What is Claude Fable 5.2? Claude Fable 5.2 is an AI model from Anthropic, released on 2026-11-09. Within days people used it to build complete browser games, 3D worlds, tools and code-driven films from prompts. Fable List tracks them: 222 live works and 146 video demos from 241 creators so far.
- What have people built with Claude Fable 5.2? By section: Games 103, 3D Worlds & Scenes 47, Web Pages & Tools 53, Animation & Film 19, Video Demos 146. The most-liked entry is Anthropic: pre-release projects by @claudeai, with 43,076 likes on X.
- How much does it cost to build something with Claude Fable 5.2? It varies a lot. In their own posts, creators report about $30 of API tokens and 1 h 18 min for Go for Launch, a one-prompt rocket game, and an estimated $2,618 for an overnight build of Rome, AD 320. Most runs fall between minutes and many hours.
- Where can I find the prompts behind these works? 38 creators published their own prompts; those cards link straight to them, free. For the other works, Fable List wrote 210 prompts reconstructed from each work's code or video and packaged them as one Claude Skill.
- How is the list checked and updated? Every link is opened before it is added. The list refreshes every 12 hours with new works and current like counts from X, and anyone can submit a work on GitHub.

## Most-liked works

- [Anthropic: pre-release projects](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/anthropic-pre-release-projects/): by @claudeai, 43,076 likes, Video Demos. What Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 built across fields during testing.
- [Starry Nightrider](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/starry-nightrider/): by @ebbyamir, 17,957 likes, Games. Van Gogh riding through his Starry Night, as a game.
- [Saltline — first-person shooter](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/saltline-first-person-shooter/): by @felixrieseberg, 15,023 likes, Games. By an Anthropic engineer. One-shot prompts, no human feedback, 8 hours, ~$550. Models, sounds and textures all generated in code.
- [A 3D film explaining Zeno's paradox](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/a-3d-film-explaining-zeno-s-paradox/): by @anxuanng, 9,957 likes, Video Demos.
- [A symphony shaped like a training run](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/a-symphony-shaped-like-a-training-run/): by @imjustnewatai, 9,658 likes, Video Demos.
- [Uno com Escada: a Fiat Uno with a ladder on a race circuit](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/uno-com-escada-a-fiat-uno-with-a/): by @ViktorKav, 9,206 likes, Games. Drive a 1996 Uno Mille with a ladder on the roof around a circuit. One 603 KB HTML file with no engine, 3D library or textures; the car, forest, sky and engine sound all come from code.
- [Oil Paint — hand-painted game](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/oil-paint-hand-painted-game/): by @BlendiByl, 8,016 likes, Games. Made in under an hour. Every frame is about 1.5 million brush strokes, running at 200 fps in a browser tab. Open source.
- [CROSSTOWN — open-world New York (early preview)](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/crosstown-open-world-new-york-early-preview/): by @mattshumer_, 7,519 likes, Games. "Rockstar took 8 years. Fable 5.2 is gonna do it in 7 days." Only part of the city is in so far; press B to send feedback.
- [2D blueprints turned into 3D walkthroughs](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/2d-blueprints-turned-into-3d-walkthroughs/): by @everestchris6, 7,306 likes, Video Demos.
- [It can actually design](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/it-can-actually-design/): by @dominikmartn, 7,250 likes, Video Demos.
- [Claude App on a Blender laptop](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/claude-app-on-a-blender-laptop/): by @rileybrown, 7,075 likes, 3D Worlds & Scenes. One prompt built the whole room in Blender and rendered it in 4K. This is the web page shown on the laptop screen.
- ["Show me your best video"](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/show-me-your-best-video/): by @suna_gaku, 6,774 likes, Video Demos.
- [Painting a copy in code — "the original has a blotch here, mine doesn't"](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/painting-a-copy-in-code-the-original-has/): by @yohakutoink, 6,480 likes, Video Demos.
- [Claudia Gallery](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/claudia-gallery/): by @anabology, 5,498 likes, Web Pages & Tools. "Make the video of your dreams" — two shots, 9 hours.
- [A mobile-game style lobby screen with a Tripo 3D model](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/a-mobile-game-style-lobby-screen-with-a/): by @Dstudio_ai, 5,319 likes, Video Demos.
- [Playing any song with 64 recorded notes of one voice](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/playing-any-song-with-64-recorded-notes-of/): by @aj_dev_smith, 5,311 likes, Video Demos.
- [One prompt: make the most uncomfortable video you can](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/one-prompt-make-the-most-uncomfortable-video-you/): by @matabee_GTO, 5,020 likes, Video Demos.
- [Pixel-art Gaussian splats](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/pixel-art-gaussian-splats-291/): by @JungleSilicon, 4,847 likes, Video Demos.
- [Robotics Lab](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/robotics-lab/): by @0xMovez, 4,683 likes, Web Pages & Tools. Eight real boards (Arduino Uno, Raspberry Pi 4…) in 3D: place chips, solder them in, wire real circuits.
- [Three Fable 5.2 agents build a computer in 7h41m](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/three-fable-5-2-agents-build-a-computer/): by @MrTacticalX, 4,572 likes, Video Demos.
- [omw: a castle valley in oil brush strokes](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/omw-a-castle-valley-in-oil-brush-strokes/): by @__morse, 4,481 likes, Games. The "omw" pixel-art post by @de5imulate rebuilt as a playable three.js game in the browser, rendered like an oil painting.
- [Atlas + Fable 5.2 + three.js](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/atlas-fable-5-2-three-js/): by @XRarchitect, 4,431 likes, Video Demos.
- [What the Water Keeps](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/what-the-water-keeps/): by @kevin_t_ngo, 4,279 likes, Games. A boat ride through 8 dreamlike worlds, playable in the browser.
- [House Bangers generator](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/house-bangers-generator/): by @deedydas, 4,058 likes, Web Pages & Tools. It learned music theory, tries thousands of patterns per instrument and arranges the best into a 72-bar house track. Sound on.
- [A video made to make you smile](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/a-video-made-to-make-you-smile/): by @shiromamono, 3,823 likes, Video Demos.
- [Crimson Loong](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/crimson-loong/): by @chetaslua, 3,741 likes, Animation & Film. A 90-second dragon film in three.js, pure code with no external assets.
- [A 6M-parameter chatbot on a Game Boy cartridge](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/a-6m-parameter-chatbot-on-a-game-boy/): by @timhwang, 3,399 likes, Video Demos.
- [The history of computer graphics, animated](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/the-history-of-computer-graphics-animated/): by @aollivier82, 3,202 likes, Video Demos.
- [Tennis](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/tennis/): by @photonstorm, 3,107 likes, Games. Asked to "go wild" making a game, it returned what looks like a Pong clone — until you play it.
- [Age of Dragon, an open world by a non-coder](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/age-of-dragon-an-open-world-by-a/): by @M__Houser, 2,629 likes, Video Demos.
- [76 single-file HTML pieces](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/76-single-file-html-pieces/): by @MiaAI_lab, 2,625 likes, Web Pages & Tools. Generative art, physics, type and UI, each with its original prompt.
- [A walk along an old station platform, via Blender MCP](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/a-walk-along-an-old-station-platform-via/): by @hayashimon1, 2,563 likes, Video Demos.
- [Small Magic — wizard sandbox](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/small-magic-wizard-sandbox/): by @BlendiByl, 2,561 likes, Games. Built in one day: 7 spells, about 1,800 destructible physics pieces, no models or textures, open source.
- [An animation made with Blender](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/an-animation-made-with-blender/): by @aecyydesign, 2,531 likes, Video Demos.

- [A message to video editors](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/a-message-to-video-editors/): by @ChrisGPT, 2,491 likes, Video Demos.
- [A day-trading game built over a weekend](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/a-day-trading-game-built-over-a-weekend/): by @kotaniko98765, 2,467 likes, Video Demos.
- [Mirror Earth](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/mirror-earth/): by @mattshumer_, 2,420 likes, Games. The whole planet as a destructible game world, with weather that matches the real Earth in real time.
- [Fishslop run](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/fishslop-run/): by @theo, 2,323 likes, Video Demos. 76 minutes, ~$42.
- [Papertrails: an endless pop-up paper world](https://fablelist.000ooo.ooo/w/papertrails-an-endless-pop-up-paper-world/): by @xikhar, 2,257 likes, 3D Worlds & Scenes. A paper figure walks on while trees, houses and hills fold up from the ground like a pop-up book, through desert, snow, forest and day and night. Built with Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5 and three.js.
